# Candidate stream mapping. Open questions: stream/PLAN.md.
domain stream-fail "Stream fail"
profile declarative-function-v1
portability node-rust-v1
owner inference-router-owner
logic sfol-v1
import Errors from "./discovery/stream-error.alch"
schema Identity:
  request_id: identifier max 128
  model: identifier max 128
schema Input:
  identity: Identity
  code: string max 256
schema Frame:
  request_id: identifier max 128
  model: identifier max 128
  error: Errors.Error
schema Output:
  status: string const "ok"
  value: Frame
mapping ErrorArgument:
  meaning "Supply only a bounded code to the existing public stream error policy."
  target Errors.Input
  field code = input.code
integration Sanitize:
  transport module-local
  module Errors
  input ErrorArgument
  output Errors.Output
  timeout-ms 5000
  max-bytes 65536
mapping Failed:
  meaning "Emit a sanitized error with pinned identity and no provider diagnostic."
  target Frame
  field request_id = input.identity.request_id
  field model = input.identity.model
  field error = mapped.error
mapping Wrapped:
  meaning "Return the terminal failure frame."
  target Output
  field status = "ok"
  field value = Failed
result Result:
  bind mapped from Sanitize
  when true yield Wrapped
endpoint Function:
  target node-http
  runtime node>=26.8.1
  method POST
  path "/internal/stream-fail"
  input Input
  output Output
  result Result
  auth-env INFERENCE_INTERNAL_TOKEN
  max-bytes 65536
  timeout-ms 5000
  error-status 422
  status ok 200

# Candidate public stream error policy. Open questions: README.md.
domain stream-error "Public stream error policy"
profile declarative-function-v1
portability node-rust-v1
owner inference-router-owner
logic sfol-v1
schema Input:
  code: string max 256
schema Error:
  code: string
schema Output:
  status: string const "ok"
  error: Error
mapping KnownError:
  meaning "Preserve a recognized public stream error code."
  target Error
  field code = input.code
mapping UnknownError:
  meaning "Hide unknown stream diagnostics."
  target Error
  field code = "PROVIDER_STREAM_FAILED"
mapping Known:
  meaning "Return the declared stream failure."
  target Output
  field status = "ok"
  field error = KnownError
mapping Unknown:
  meaning "Return only a sanitized fallback."
  target Output
  field status = "ok"
  field error = UnknownError
result Result:
  when input.code == "CANCELLED" or input.code == "DEADLINE_EXCEEDED" or input.code == "RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE" or input.code == "EVENT_TOO_LARGE" or input.code == "INCOMPLETE_PROVIDER_STREAM" or input.code == "INVALID_PROVIDER_EVENT" or input.code == "PROVIDER_STREAM_ERROR" or input.code == "INVALID_PROVIDER_RESPONSE" yield Known
  when input.code != "CANCELLED" and input.code != "DEADLINE_EXCEEDED" and input.code != "RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE" and input.code != "EVENT_TOO_LARGE" and input.code != "INCOMPLETE_PROVIDER_STREAM" and input.code != "INVALID_PROVIDER_EVENT" and input.code != "PROVIDER_STREAM_ERROR" and input.code != "INVALID_PROVIDER_RESPONSE" yield Unknown
endpoint Function:
  target node-http
  runtime node>=26.8.1
  method POST
  path "/internal/stream-error"
  input Input
  output Output
  result Result
  auth-env INFERENCE_INTERNAL_TOKEN
  max-bytes 1024
  timeout-ms 5000
  error-status 422
  status ok 200
